Madrid maps

Explore historical maps of Madrid from 1622 to 1960 and compare them with today's map. Cartography is provided by Spain's Instituto Geográfico Nacional.

Maps cover different areas. Older surveys may not match today's streets exactly, and some collections contain gaps between sheets. Address search uses present-day locations from CartoCiudad and OpenStreetMap.
